canonical.name: Pure-state trace distance is bounded by vector error
canonical.detail: Rank-two spectral proof computes the exact trace distance and bounds it by vector error, including parallel vectors.

canonical.name: Clean-ancilla zero-branch postselection
canonical.detail: Defines the clean injection, projector and two branch weights, with an explicit zero-probability convention.

canonical.name: Partial trace contracts the trace norm on Hermitian operators
canonical.detail: Proves the Hermitian trace-norm variational identity locally and derives partial-trace contractivity, including zero-dimensional factors.

canonical.name: Clean-ancilla postselection has normalized branch weights
canonical.detail: Proves the orthogonal branch decomposition, normalized weights, and conditional-vector boundary cases.

canonical.name: LCU decomposition and access model
canonical.detail: Fixes the finite LCU list, complete PREPARE/SELECT behavior, inverse/controlled declarations, padding, and separate resource coordinates.

canonical.name: LCU block encoding
canonical.detail: Defines the full P† SELECT P circuit and its explicit access charges.

canonical.name: Oblivious ancilla reflection
canonical.detail: Fixes R₀=I−2Π₀ and the opposite-sign controlled-reflection correction.

canonical.name: Finite Taylor LCU polynomial
canonical.detail: Expands the finite Taylor polynomial into ordered product terms and defines cancelling ±qI padding.

canonical.name: LCU projected-block and postselection correctness
canonical.detail: Proves the clean projected block M/α, input-dependent branch weight, and zero-success convention.

canonical.name: One-step oblivious amplitude amplification
canonical.detail: Defines the chronological three-use circuit and retains its explicit global phase.

canonical.name: Taylor simulation tail bound
canonical.detail: Proves the finite-dimensional operator tail, coefficient-sum bound, factorial estimate, and truncation order.

canonical.name: Oblivious-amplification block identity
canonical.detail: Expands the two projector reflections and derives the cubic projected-block polynomial.

canonical.name: Robust one-step OAA including ancilla leakage
canonical.detail: Proves the clean-input isometry estimate including residual ancilla leakage and finite references.

canonical.name: Segmented Taylor LCU simulator
canonical.detail: Specifies certified segmentation and truncation, fresh work registers, padding, access calls, and per-call error budget.

canonical.name: Segmented Taylor error and resources
canonical.detail: Telescopes segment and compilation errors, purifies mixed inputs, traces out work, and counts calls and widths.
